sources.title: BananaMind 2 AI Detect - a Hugging Face Space by Banaxi-Tech
sources.snippet: 🍌 BananaMind 2 AI Detect Human-vs-AI text detector — a full fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-.8B-Base on the RAID benchmark (GPT-4 vs. human). Paste a passage and the model predicts whether it was written by a human or generated by AI. ⚠️ Heads up: trained on a single generator (GPT-4). It behaves more like a "GPT-4 vs. not-GPT-4" classifier than a universal detector, and it is untested ...

sources.title: Nano Banana 2: Google's latest AI image generation model
sources.snippet: Nano Banana 2 brings Gemini Flash's speed to image generation, enabling rapid edits. Enjoy enhanced creative control with subject consistency and precise instruction following. Nano Banana 2 is rolling out across Google products like Gemini, Search, and Ads. Google is improving AI image identification with SynthID and C2PA Content Credentials.
